notes.title: Small Fixes - #1
notes.content:
- Fixed a few renders. 
- Fixed a ton of spelling and grammar errors throughout the game. (More to come.)

Please report bugs, etc., through Discord and the bug-report channel. 


A big thanks to Chugworth for a whole bunch of fixes.
